label: copy phase: fed-back a, about to output a/w/b/s
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (99.9% of mass) on steps where the fed-back input is the letter a (100% of activations have in_tok a; never on the first occurrence of a). Needs recall_idx >= 3, with almost nothing at recall 0-2. Magnitude depends mostly on the token being output: highest when out_tok is a (40% of mass, e.g. a repeated a-a in the original), then w and b, then s; m/k/i/l are weaker. Rate also goes up toward the end of the copy (to_go 0 holds 44% of mass). Does not fire in the original or delimiter phase or on any other input token. Fed-back a alone is only 6.5% precise, so the output-token condition does most of the selection, and the output set is graded rather than sharp. That makes this partial.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=7: a; t=13: a; t=14: a) and the token being output (most: a, w, b, s, m, k; least: x, h, 2, 3); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, L=4 & t=7, to_go=0.
